protocol: Generated before the matcher redesign; questions never inspected; evaluated with --aggregate-only exactly once before (old matcher) and once after the design was frozen (two-stage matcher). The script's internal dev/held_out split is irrelevant here: all 46 questions are held-out.

before.matcher: single-problem LLM verdict + question-wide service gate
before.source: console output of `python -m evals.evaluate_matcher --file evals/testsets/matcher_heldout_v2.jsonl --exclude-run none --aggregate-only`, 2026-10-24 (not saved to a file at the time; transcribed from the session log)

after.matcher: Stage A (unchanged prompt) + Stage B requirement decomposition (gap-filling only) + per-requirement service, severity and generic-requirement rules
